name: Avalanche centre
description: A regional avalanche bulletin site: region tabs, today's danger level with its rose and problems, a map of zones tinted by level, a seven-day history and a searchable archive.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Portraits keyed by forecaster name (Yuna Sato, Kenta Hoshino, Mio Arai, Daichi Kudo), shown beside each region's forecaster note.

props.name: map
props.description: Image drawn faintly under the region map, such as contour lines. Without one the zones sit on a plain well.

props.name: defaultRegion
props.description: The region shown first. The tabs, the zones on the map and the archive all follow the chosen region.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls; the region tabs stay pinned to the top. Also accepts every other div attribute.
